read: Inflation is re-accelerating, with CPI at 3.7% and the Fed at 3.75–4.00% after a September hike. Unemployment has edged up to 4.20%. Ten-year yields near 5.1% and mortgage rates at 7.40% are squeezing housing, while an AI-led tech selloff and high oil prices add pressure.
